title: Clearstory for Specialty Contractors
finding: Clearstory describes field photos/signatures, T&M-to-change-order conversion, shared log via link, estimates and review. This is substantial overlap with R1-I-01; vendor outcome percentages are NOT independently validated.

title: Opus1 makeup lessons setup
finding: Make-up credits, self-booking, same-teacher restrictions, cancellation-only availability and policies exist. Occupied-slot multi-party exchanges were not established by this limited inspected page.

title: Omaha Conservatory 2025-26 FAQ
finding: School explicitly encourages students to arrange swaps with others in same studio when missing lessons; alternatives include virtual lessons/absence. School uses Opus1 and admissions updates schedules. Supports real workaround, not willingness to buy another tool.

title: Claimlane furniture returns and claims
finding: Claimlane describes guided self-service gathering photos/serial numbers and handling spare parts, repairs, technicians, refunds and returns, including complex furniture. Major overlap with R1-I-04.

title: Ashley FAQ
finding: Published policies include repair/replacement and return conditions by fulfillment/product context. Does not demonstrate adoption or pain of small SEA furniture sellers. No universal legal conclusion.

title: How Swimm Auto-sync works
date: Exact publication UNKNOWN; search index says older article
finding: Swimm analyzes changed code and linked tokens/paths, automatically updates some snippets and asks humans to review others. Overlap with documentation invalidation mechanism; date/availability of exact current entitlement UNKNOWN.

title: SurveyCTO collecting high-quality data
finding: SurveyCTO documents automated checks, review/correction, automation of back-check workflow, random audits, exports and spreadsheet review. Major overlap with R1-I-07; not proof a targeted allocation niche cannot exist.

title: Footwear BOM and material substitution approval
type: supplier marketing guide; low evidential strength
finding: Guide says preapproved alternatives must specify identities, scope, conditions and evidence; otherwise human review/approval. Sector differs from garments; cannot validate acceptance of generic substitution rules.

title: Godot docs issue 10020
finding: Issue reports tutorial referencing deprecated call and mismatched screenshots; a later commenter reports more than four hours spent. Self-report, one selected OSS context, no commercial buyer proof.

title: Besu docs issue 1035
finding: Maintainer report describes config changes breaking a tutorial while URL still responds; proposes commit permalinks and scheduled checks. Evidence both of problem mechanism and cheap substitute, not current unmet demand.
